exercises.instructions: 阅读以下段落，判断各句是TRUE、FALSE还是NOT GIVEN。
exercises.passage: The honeybee, a vital pollinator for many crops, has been facing significant population declines in recent decades. Scientists have identified several factors contributing to this phenomenon, including pesticide use, habitat loss, and climate change. While some researchers argue that monoculture farming practices are the primary cause, others believe that a combination of stressors is responsible. In response to this crisis, the European Union has implemented strict regulations on neonicotinoid pesticides, which have been shown to harm bees. However, agricultural industry groups continue to debate the extent of the pesticide impact, suggesting that more research is needed before further restrictions are imposed.

questions.text: Honeybees are important for the production of many crops.
Climate change is the main reason for the decline in honeybee populations.
All researchers agree that monoculture farming is the primary cause of bee population decline.
The European Union has banned all types of pesticides.
Agricultural industry groups believe that neonicotinoid pesticides have no effect on bees.

explanations: 文中第一句明确提到'honeybee, a vital pollinator for many crops'，vital = important，因此为TRUE。
文中说climate change是several factors之一，但没有说是main reason。main reason与原文矛盾，因此为FALSE。
文中说'While some researchers argue... others believe...'，说明研究人员意见不一致，因此'all researchers agree'为FALSE。
文中说EU实施了strict regulations on neonicotinoid pesticides，不是banned all types of pesticides，范围扩大，因此为FALSE。
文中说农业团体认为需要更多研究，但没有说他们相信农药对蜜蜂没有影响。这是未提及的信息，因此为NOT GIVEN。
exercises.tips: 判断题核心技巧：①TRUE = 原文同义表达 ②FALSE = 与原文矛盾 ③NOT GIVEN = 原文未提及。常见陷阱：绝对词（all/only/never）往往是FALSE信号；比较级（more than/better）若原文无比较则为NOT GIVEN。

exercises.passage: The history of chocolate began in Mesoamerica, where the cacao tree is native. The Olmec civilization was the first to cultivate cacao around 1500 BC, using it primarily for religious ceremonies. Later, the Maya and Aztec cultures also valued cacao, preparing a bitter drink called 'xocolatl' which was believed to have medicinal properties. questions.text: The cacao tree originally grew in the region known as __________.
The first civilization to grow cacao was the __________, who used it mainly for religious purposes.
The ancient drink 'xocolatl' was thought to have __________ qualities.

The invention of __________ chocolate in the 1800s made it available to everyone.

explanations: 定位词：cacao tree originally grew。原文第一句'where the cacao tree is native'，native = originally grew。

定位词：xocolatl / qualities。原文'believed to have medicinal properties'，qualities = properties。
定位词：Spanish explorers / century。原文'in the 16th century'。
定位词：Europe / added / taste better。原文'sugar was added to create a more palatable beverage'，palatable = taste better。
定位词：1800s / available to everyone。原文'production of solid chocolate, transforming it from an elite luxury into a mass-market product'。

From diagnostic imaging to drug discovery, AI algorithms are demonstrating remarkable accuracy and efficiency. A recent study published in The Lancet showed that an AI system could detect breast cancer in mammograms with greater accuracy than human radiologists, reducing false positives by 5.7% and false negatives by 9.4%. questions.text: According to the passage, the AI system mentioned in The Lancet study could:

C. Only reduce false positives in mammograms

B. Doctors should not use AI at all
C. AI can help doctors focus on more complex cases
D. Routine screening should be eliminated

options: A. Strongly opposed to AI in healthcare
B. Completely supportive of replacing doctors with AI
D. Highly skeptical about AI technology

explanations: 原文明确说'AI system could detect breast cancer in mammograms with greater accuracy than human radiologists'，因此选B。A选项'replace completely'与原文矛盾；C选项'only reduce false positives'过于片面；D选项未提及。

answers:
The person I really admire is my aunt, who is a pediatric nurse at a children's hospital in my hometown. I've known her since I was born, as she is my mother's younger sister, so she's been part of my life for as long as I can remember.

She has been working as a nurse for over fifteen years, specifically in the pediatric department where she takes care of children with serious illnesses. Her job is incredibly demanding because she often works night shifts and has to deal with emotionally difficult situations when children don't respond well to treatment.

The reason I admire her so much is her extraordinary compassion and resilience. Despite the challenges, she always maintains a positive attitude and treats every child with genuine warmth and patience. I remember once visiting her at work and seeing how she comforted a scared little boy before his surgery. She sat with him for nearly an hour, telling him stories until he stopped crying.

What inspires me most is that she chose this career not for money or status, but because she truly wants to make a difference in children's lives. She often says that seeing a child recover and smile is the greatest reward she could ever ask for. Moreover, the attention to detail in everything—from the meticulously maintained gardens to the beautifully presented food—reflects a deep respect for aesthetics and craftsmanship. This experience made me reflect on how modern cities often sacrifice tradition for development, and I believe Kyoto offers an inspiring model of how both can coexist beautifully.

exercises.instructions:
请根据以下题目写一篇250词以上的议论文。

Some people think that the best way to reduce crime is to give longer prison sentences. Others believe there are better alternatives.
Discuss both views and give your opinion.
answers:
It is true that punishing criminals by sending them to prison serves as a deterrent and ensures public safety. However, I believe that addressing the root causes of crime and implementing rehabilitation programs are more effective long-term solutions.

On the one hand, longer prison sentences can discourage potential offenders from committing crimes. When the consequences are severe, individuals may think twice before breaking the law. Additionally, imprisoning dangerous criminals protects society from violent behavior and gives victims a sense of justice. For serious offenses such as murder or armed robbery, lengthy imprisonment is undoubtedly necessary.

On the other hand, simply extending prison terms does not address why people turn to crime in the first place. Many offenders come from disadvantaged backgrounds with limited education and employment opportunities. By investing in education, vocational training, and community support programs, governments can help individuals build legitimate careers rather than resorting to illegal activities. Furthermore, rehabilitation programs within prisons, such as counseling and skill development, can prepare inmates for successful reintegration into society.

In conclusion, while long prison sentences have a role in dealing with serious criminals, I believe that prevention and rehabilitation should be the primary focus. By tackling the underlying causes of crime and helping offenders transform their lives, society can achieve more sustainable reductions in criminal activity.

(Word count: 268)
explanations:
范文结构分析：
①Introduction：背景句 + 明确立场（I believe that...）
②Body 1：反方观点（longer sentences的好处）+ 具体例子（murder/armed robbery）
③Body 2：正方观点（alternatives的好处）+ 具体建议（education/vocational training/rehabilitation）
④Conclusion：重申立场 + 总结理由

高分表达：
- serves as a deterrent
- addressing the root causes
- disadvantaged backgrounds
- vocational training
- reintegration into society
- tackling the underlying causes

A truly memorable event in my life was my graduation ceremony from university, which took place two years ago in the grand auditorium of my campus. I was surrounded by my parents, my closest friends, and several professors who had guided me throughout my academic journey.

The ceremony itself was quite formal, with hundreds of graduates wearing black gowns and caps. When my name was called, I walked across the stage to receive my diploma, and I could see my parents waving enthusiastically from the audience. What made it even more special was that I was awarded distinction for my final year project, which meant I had to stay on stage a bit longer while the dean congratulated me personally.

What made this event so memorable was the sense of achievement and closure it represented. For four years, I had worked incredibly hard, sacrificing weekends and holidays to complete assignments and prepare for exams. Standing on that stage, I realized that all those late nights and stressful moments had been worthwhile.

Moreover, it was a moment of transition. I knew that after this ceremony, I would be entering the professional world, leaving behind the familiar comfort of student life. The mixture of pride, nostalgia, and excitement I felt that day is something I will cherish forever. It taught me that significant accomplishments require persistence, and that celebrating milestones with loved ones makes success even more meaningful.

answers:
Traffic congestion has become a pressing issue in urban areas worldwide, causing significant economic losses and reducing residents' quality of life. This essay will examine the primary causes of this problem and propose effective solutions.

There are two main factors contributing to severe traffic jams in cities. Firstly, rapid urbanization has led to a dramatic increase in private car ownership. As people's incomes rise, more families can afford vehicles, resulting in roads that were designed for much lower volumes being overwhelmed. Secondly, inadequate public transportation infrastructure forces commuters to rely on personal vehicles. In many developing cities, bus and metro networks fail to cover suburban areas or operate at insufficient frequencies during peak hours.

To address these issues, governments should implement a multi-faceted approach. One effective measure would be to invest heavily in expanding and improving public transit systems. By adding metro lines, increasing bus frequencies, and creating dedicated bus lanes, cities can provide attractive alternatives to driving. Additionally, introducing congestion charges in city centers, as London and Singapore have successfully done, would discourage unnecessary car journeys during busy periods. Finally, promoting remote work policies and flexible working hours could spread commuter traffic more evenly throughout the day.

In conclusion, while traffic congestion stems from rising car ownership and inadequate public transport, coordinated efforts involving infrastructure investment, congestion pricing, and flexible work arrangements can significantly alleviate this problem.

The reason I want to visit Iceland so much is that it represents the raw power and beauty of nature in its purest form. As someone who lives in a bustling city, I crave the tranquility and vastness that Iceland offers. I believe standing beneath the Northern Lights or walking across a glacier would give me a profound sense of perspective and remind me how small we are in the grand scheme of things. resources.name: 新东方雅思官网阅读练习

exercises.instructions: 分析以下长难句，找出主干和从句。

questions.text: Sentence 1: The theory, which was first proposed by Darwin in 1859 and has since been supported by extensive fossil evidence, suggests that all species evolved from common ancestors through a process called natural selection.

Sentence 2: Although many researchers initially dismissed the findings as coincidental, subsequent studies, conducted over a period of fifteen years across multiple continents, have consistently replicated the original results, thereby confirming the validity of the hypothesis.

Sentence 3: What concerns environmentalists most is not the immediate damage caused by the oil spill itself, but the long-term ecological consequences that may persist for decades, affecting marine biodiversity and coastal communities that depend on fishing for their livelihood.

answers:
主干：The theory suggests that all species evolved from common ancestors.
从句1：which was first proposed by Darwin in 1859 and has since been supported by extensive fossil evidence（非限制性定语从句，修饰theory）
从句2：that all species evolved from common ancestors（宾语从句，suggests的宾语）
分词结构：called natural selection（过去分词，修饰process）

主干：subsequent studies have consistently replicated the original results.
从句1：Although many researchers initially dismissed the findings as coincidental（让步状语从句）
分词结构：conducted over a period of fifteen years across multiple continents（过去分词，修饰studies）
副词结构：thereby confirming the validity of the hypothesis（现在分词，表结果）

主干：What concerns environmentalists most is not the immediate damage but the long-term ecological consequences.
从句1：What concerns environmentalists most（主语从句）
从句2：caused by the oil spill itself（过去分词，修饰damage）
从句3：that may persist for decades（定语从句，修饰consequences）
从句4：affecting marine biodiversity and coastal communities（现在分词，表伴随）
从句5：that depend on fishing for their livelihood（定语从句，修饰communities）
explanations: 分析步骤：①找谓语动词（was proposed, has been supported, suggests, evolved）②找主语（The theory）③找宾语（that从句）④识别修饰成分（which从句、called分词）。
分析步骤：①Although引导让步从句，可暂时忽略 ②主干：subsequent studies... have replicated... results ③conducted分词修饰studies ④thereby confirming表结果。
分析步骤：①What concerns...是主语从句 ②not...but...结构连接两个表语 ③多个从句层层修饰：consequences → that may persist → affecting... → that depend on...
exercises.tips: 长难句分析技巧：①先找谓语动词（几个动词就有几个从句/分句）②找连接词（which/that/although/what）③忽略修饰成分，抓主干（谁做了什么）④注意嵌套结构（从句套从句）⑤每天分析3-5个长难句，2周后阅读速度明显提升

exercises.instructions:
请根据以下题目写一篇250词以上的议论文。

Some people believe that the purpose of education is to prepare individuals for employment, while others think it should aim to develop personal growth and critical thinking.
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
answers:
The fundamental purpose of education has been debated for centuries, with some arguing that its primary role is to equip students with job-specific skills, while others emphasize the development of well-rounded individuals capable of independent thought.

Those who prioritize employment preparation argue that education should be practical and directly relevant to industry needs. In an increasingly competitive job market, graduates need specific technical competencies, such as programming, data analysis, or engineering skills, to secure well-paying positions. Vocational schools and specialized degree programs are designed precisely for this purpose, and their graduates often find employment more quickly than those with general academic backgrounds. Furthermore, when education aligns with economic demands, it contributes to national productivity and reduces unemployment rates.

On the other hand, proponents of personal growth and critical thinking argue that education should transcend mere job training. They believe that cultivating analytical abilities, creativity, and ethical reasoning produces citizens who can adapt to changing circumstances and contribute meaningfully to society. A broad education in humanities, sciences, and arts fosters intellectual curiosity and emotional intelligence, qualities that remain valuable throughout life regardless of career changes. History shows that many influential thinkers and innovators were shaped by diverse educational experiences rather than narrow technical training.

In my view, while employment preparation is undoubtedly important, education should ultimately serve both purposes. A balanced approach that combines practical skills with intellectual development produces not only competent workers but also thoughtful, adaptable individuals who can navigate an unpredictable future.

(Word count: 273)
explanations:
范文结构分析：
①Introduction：背景句 + 双方观点概述
②Body 1（就业准备方）：3个论点（competitive job market, vocational schools, national productivity）
③Body 2（个人成长方）：3个论点（transcend job training, analytical abilities, historical evidence）
④Conclusion：个人立场（balanced approach serving both purposes）

高分表达：
- fundamental purpose

- increasingly competitive
- transcend mere job training
- cultivating analytical abilities
- intellectual curiosity
- navigate an unpredictable future
exercises.tips:

②使用具体例子（vocational schools, programming, data analysis）而非泛泛而谈
③个人立场要明确，可以支持一方或提出平衡观点
④使用学术词汇：prioritize, proponents, transcend, cultivate, foster, navigate

tasks.title: 【练习】口语Part 2 - Describe a challenging thing you did
tasks.description: 练习事件类Part 2（挑战类）。

exercises.instructions:
Describe a challenging thing you have done.
You should say:
- What it was
- When and where you did it
- Who helped you
- And explain how you felt about it
answers:
One of the most challenging things I've ever done was organizing a charity fundraising event for a local children's hospital last year. It took place at my university over the course of three months, and I worked alongside five classmates who shared my passion for community service.

The challenge was multifaceted. Firstly, we had to secure a venue, which involved negotiating with the university administration and obtaining various permits. Secondly, we needed to recruit performers and sponsors, which meant countless cold calls and emails to local businesses. The most difficult aspect was managing our team dynamics, as we had conflicting ideas about how the event should be structured. There were moments when I felt overwhelmed and doubted whether we could pull it off.

What helped me persevere was the support of my teammates and the thought of the children who would benefit from our efforts. We divided responsibilities according to each person's strengths, held weekly progress meetings, and maintained open communication when disagreements arose.

When the event finally took place and we raised over 10,000 yuan, I felt an immense sense of accomplishment and pride. The experience taught me that leadership is not about having all the answers but about bringing people together toward a common goal. It also made me realize that challenges, while stressful in the moment, often become the most meaningful and transformative experiences in retrospect.
explanations:

①流利度：使用One of the most challenging things I've ever done开场，定语从句（who shared my passion）使叙述连贯。
②词汇：使用multifaceted, secure a venue, negotiating, conflicting ideas, overwhelmed, persevere, immense sense of accomplishment等高级词汇。
③语法：使用过去完成时（had done, had secured），when引导时间状语从句，that引导宾语从句。

Overall, fossil fuels remained the dominant source of energy throughout this period, while there was a notable shift toward renewable energy sources. Coal and oil experienced opposite trends, and nuclear energy maintained a relatively stable contribution.

In 1995, coal was the largest energy source, accounting for approximately 45% of total production. Oil constituted roughly 30%, while natural gas and nuclear power each represented about 10%. Renewable sources, including hydroelectric, wind, and solar, made up only 5% of the total.
